title: Houthi rebel advance in Yemen may further destabilise global economy
english: Houthi rebels have gained control of the Yemeni Red Sea coastline, threatening the critical Bab al-Mandab Strait, a vital passage for global maritime trade. This advance jeopardizes Saudi Arabia’s alternative oil export route, which was established to avoid regional instability elsewhere. The situation raises significant concerns that further disruptions to these shipping lanes could trigger global economic instability and higher fuel prices.
amharic: የሁቲ አማጽያን በየመን የቀይ ባህር ዳርቻ ላይ ቁጥጥር በማድረጋቸው ለዓለም አቀፍ የንግድ መርከቦች ወሳኝ የሆነውን የባብ አል-ማንዳብ ስትሬት ስጋት ላይ ጥለዋል። ይህ አካሄድ ሳዑዲ አረቢያ ሌሎች አካባቢዎች ካለው አለመረጋጋት ለመራቅ ትጠቀምበት የነበረውን አማራጭ የነዳጅ ማስተላለፊያ መንገድ አደጋ ላይ ጥሎታል። በነዚህ የባህር መስመሮች ላይ የሚፈጠር ማንኛውም መስተጓጎል በዓለም አቀፍ ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ጫና በመፍጠር የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲንር ሊያደርግ ይችላል።
oromo: Warra Hutiin qarqara galaana diimaa Yaman to'annoo isaanii jala galchuun, iddoo daldala addunyaaf murteessaa ta'e Bab al-Mandab irratti soda uumaniiru. Tarkaanfin kun, Sa'udii Arabiyaan bakka biroo keessatti waraana fi bu'aa ba'ii irraa ooluuf iddoo gurgurtaan ishee itti fayyadamaa turte miidhuu danda'a. Haalli kun, yoo daandiiwwan galaana kanaa cufaman ykn midhaman, dinagdee addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuu fi gatiin boba'aa akka dabalu sodaa uumee jira.

title: Yemeni army reports 661 attacks on Houthis as group advances towards Aden
english: The Yemeni military launched over 600 strikes against Houthi forces in a major counter-offensive, resulting in 173 Houthi casualties and significant equipment destruction. These actions occur as the government attempts to regroup and defend its temporary capital, Aden, following recent territorial losses to Houthi fighters near the Red Sea. In tandem with the military campaign, the Yemeni parliament has officially labeled the Houthi movement a terrorist organization to restrict its operations and funding.
amharic: የየመን ጦር በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ ከ600 በላይ ጥቃቶችን በመፈጸም 173 ተዋጊዎችን መግደሉን ወይም ማቁሰሉን አስታውቋል። ይህ ዘመቻ የተካሄደው የየመን መንግሥት በቅርቡ የተወሰዱበትን ቦታዎች በማስመለስ ጊዜያዊ መቀመጫው የሆነችውን ኤደን ከተማን ለመከላከል በሚያደርገው ጥረት ውስጥ ነው። ከዚህ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ጎን ለጎን፣ የየመን ፓርላማ የሁቲ ቡድንን እንደ አሸባሪ ድርጅት በመፈረጅ የገንዘብ እና የጦር መሳርያ አቅርቦታቸውን ለመገደብ ወስኗል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyya Yaman humnoota Huutii irratti haleellaa 600 ol gaggeessuun, lolaa 173 ta’an ajjeesuus ykn madeessuus isaa beeksiseera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, mootummaan Yaman bakka dhabe deebisee qabachuufi magaalaa Aden ittisuuf yaalii gochaa jiru keessatti. Tarkaanfii waraana kana cinaatti, mana maree Yaman garee Huutii akka dhaabbata shororkeessaaatti moggaasuun, sosochii fi deeggarsa qarshii isaanii ittisuuf murteesseera.

title: Irish court jails man for life over Dublin knife attack that sparked riots
english: A 52-year-old man named Riad Bouchaker has been sentenced to life in prison for a 2023 knife attack in Dublin that severely injured three children and a woman. The horrific incident occurred outside a school and caused one young victim to suffer permanent, life-altering disabilities. Following the attack, false information spread online, leading to significant civil unrest and riots across the Irish capital.
amharic: ሪያድ ቡቻከር የተባለ የ52 ዓመት ሰው እ.ኤ.አ በ2023 በደብሊን ሶስት ህጻናትን እና አንዲት ሴትን በቢላ በመውጋቱ የዕድሜ ልክ እስራት ተፈርዶበታል። በትምህርት ቤት አቅራቢያ የተፈጸመው ይህ አሰቃቂ ጥቃት በአንዲት ህጻን ላይ ዘላቂ ጉዳት አስከትሏል። ጥቃቱን ተከትሎ በማህበራዊ ድረ-ገጾች በተሰራጨ የተሳሳተ መረጃ ምክንያት በደብሊን ከተማ ከፍተኛ ረብሻ እና ሁከት ተቀስቅሶ ነበር።
oromo: Namni umuriin isaa waggaa 52, Riyaad Buuchaaker jedhamu, bara 2023 magaalaa Dabliin keessatti ijoollee sadii fi dubartii tokko waraane miidhuusaatiin hidha cimaa waggaa guutuu itti murteeffame. Haleellaan suukanneessaan mana barumsaa fuulduratti raawwatame kun miidhaa qaamaa cimaa ijoollee xiqqaarratti geessiseera. Haleellaa kana booda odeeffannoo sobaa marsariitiiwwan hawaasaa irratti faca'een walqabatee, magaalaa Dabliin keessatti jeequmsi guddaanii fi fincilli uumamee ture.

title: EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
english: Several European nations, including Germany and Greece, have reached an agreement to establish a migration processing hub in Rwanda. This facility will house individuals whose asylum applications have been rejected by EU member states. The centre is expected to become operational by 2027.
amharic: የጀርመንን እና የግሪክን ጨምሮ በርካታ የአውሮፓ ሀገራት በሩዋንዳ የስደተኞች መመለሻ ማዕከል ለማቋቋም ስምምነት ላይ ደርሰዋል። ይህ ማዕከል በአውሮፓ ህብረት አባል ሀገራት የጥገኝነት ጥያቄያቸው ውድቅ የተደረገባቸውን ሰዎች የሚያስተናግድ ይሆናል። ማዕከሉ በ2027 ዓ.ም. ሙሉ በሙሉ ስራ ይጀምራል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Biyyoonni Awurooppaa hedduun, kanneen akka Jarmanii fi Giriikii, Ruwaandaa keessatti bakka godaantota deebisan hundeessuuf waliigalteerra ga'aniiru. Bakki kun namoota biyyoota Gamtaa Awurooppaa keessatti hayyama dawoo dhaban kan keessummeessu ta'a. Buufatni kun bara 2027tti hojii akka jalqabu ni eegama.

title: Ukraine holds peace talks with US, Europe as conflict escalates
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has engaged in complex peace discussions with US and European representatives to address the ongoing conflict. Despite these diplomatic efforts, tensions remain high as both Russia and Ukraine have exchanged significant attacks on key infrastructure, including bridges and oil facilities. US officials involved in the talks noted that while progress is being made, reaching a final peace agreement will require difficult compromises from all sides.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ በጦርነቱ ላይ መፍትሄ ለመፈለግ ከአሜሪካ እና ከአውሮፓ ተወካዮች ጋር አስቸጋሪ የሰላም ንግግሮችን እያደረጉ ነው። ምንም እንኳን የዲፕሎማሲ ጥረቶች ቢኖሩም፣ ሩሲያ እና ዩክሬን በድልድዮች እና በነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጥቃቶችን በመፈጸማቸው ውጥረቱ አሁንም ከፍተኛ ነው። በንግግሮቹ ውስጥ የተሳተፉ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ምንም እንኳን የእድገት ምልክቶች ቢታዩም፣ የመጨረሻ ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ ሁሉም ወገኖች ከባድ ውሳኔዎችን መወሰን እንዳለባቸው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimiir Zelenski waraana kana xumuruuf jecha bakka bu'oota Ameerikaa fi Awurooppaa waliin marii nagaa ulfaataa ta'e gochaa jiru. Tattaaffii diippiloomaasii kana jiraatus, biyyoonni lameen bu'uuraalee misoomaa fi iddoowwan qulqullina boba'aa irratti haleellaa cimaa raawwachaa waan jiraniif walitti bu'iinsi kun itti fufee jira. Qaamoleen marii kana irratti hirmaatan akka jedhanitti, furmaata dhumaa irratti gahuuf gamni hunduu murtoo cimaa akka fudhatu gaafata jedhaniiru.

title: UK seeks closer ties with EU after Brexit fail
english: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has admitted that Brexit has caused more economic damage than benefits over the last decade. He is now pushing for a closer relationship with the European Union to reverse the country's growing isolation and improve trade. A key summit is planned this Friday, where the government hopes to finalize agreements on energy, food exports, and youth work mobility.
amharic: የብሪታኒያው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም የብሬክዚት ውሳኔ ባለፉት አስር አመታት ከጥቅሙ ይልቅ ጉዳቱ እንዳመዘነ ገልጸዋል። አሁን ባለው ሁኔታ ሀገሪቱ ያጋጠማትን ዓለም አቀፍ መገለል ለመቅረፍ ከአውሮፓ ህብረት ጋር የጠበቀ ግንኙነት ለመፍጠር እየሰሩ ነው። በዚህ አርብ በሚካሄድ ወሳኝ ስብሰባ ላይ በሃይል፣ በምግብ ንግድ እና በወጣቶች የሥራ ልውውጥ ዙሪያ አዳዲስ ስምምነቶችን ለመፈራረም መንግስት እቅድ ይዟል።
oromo: Muummee Ministiraa Biriteen Andy Burnham, Brexit waggoota kurnan darban keessa fayidaarra miidhaa guddaa akka geessise ibsaniiru. Yeroo ammaa biyyattii addunyaarraa adda baatee jirtu deebisanii gabbisuuf, Gamtaa Awurooppaa waliin hariiroo cimaa uumuu akka barbaadan beekameera. Jimaata dhufu walgahii guddaa gaggeeffamu irratti, mootummaan dhimmoota anniisaa, daldala midhaan nyaataa fi carraa hojii dargaggootaa irratti waliigaltee haarawa taasisuuf karoorfateera.

title: Vance says war on Iran will not become a long-term commitment
english: US Vice President JD Vance stated that any potential military action against Iran will not result in a prolonged, multi-year conflict. While acknowledging that Iran's nuclear activities pose a security risk to the United States, he emphasized that the government is committed to a short-term approach. Vance expressed confidence that the current administration will achieve its objectives quickly and withdraw American forces without an indefinite engagement.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ ከኢራን ጋር ሊኖር ስለሚችል ወታደራዊ ግጭት ሲናገሩ፣ ይህ ጦርነት ለረጅም ጊዜ የሚዘልቅ እንደማይሆን ገልጸዋል። የኢራን የኒውክሌር ፕሮግራም ለአሜሪካ ስጋት መሆኑን ቢጠቅሱም፣ መንግሥታቸው ግጭቱን ለብዙ ዓመታት ለማቆየት ፍላጎት እንደሌለው አስረድተዋል። አሁን ያለው አስተዳደር ግቡን በፍጥነት አሳክቶ ወታደሮቹን በቅርቡ እንደሚያስወጣ ሙሉ እምነት እንዳላቸው ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Itti-aanaan Pirezidaantii Ameerikaa JD Vance akka jedhanitti, lola gara fuulduraa kan Iran wajjin ta’uu danda’u yeroo dheeraaf kan turu miti. Sagantaan niwukilaraa Iran biyya Ameerikaaf yaaddoo ta’us, mootummaan isaanii lola kana waggoota hedduuf tursiisuuf karoora akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Pirezidaantichi kaayyoo isaa dafee galmaan gahuun waraana Ameerikaa yeroodhaan akka baasu guutummaatti amanuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Casualties in Israeli settler attack rises
english: Israeli settlers carried out a shooting attack in the West Bank village of al-Duyuk al-Tahta, resulting in the death of a 60-year-old woman. Additionally, ten other individuals, including a 65-year-old man, sustained injuries during the incident. Authorities are currently reporting an increase in the number of casualties following this violent assault near Jericho.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ አል-ዱዩክ አል-ታህታ መንደር በእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በተፈጸመ ተኩስ የአርባ ዓመት ሴት ህይወት አልፏል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም አንድ የ65 ዓመት አዛውንትን ጨምሮ ሌሎች አስር ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በኢያሪኮ አቅራቢያ በተፈጸመው በዚህ ጥቃት የተጎጂዎች ቁጥር እየጨመረ መምጣቱ ተነግሯል።
oromo: Godina Lixaa (West Bank) ganda al-Duyuk al-Tahta jedhamutti namoota qubatanii jiraatan kan Israa'el ta'aniin dhukaasa banameen dubartii umriin ishee waggaa 60 ta'e lubbuun ishee darbeera. Kana malees, namoonni biroo kudhan kan keessatti argaman yoo ta'u, isaan keessaa dhiira umriin isaa waggaa 65 ta'e tokko madaa'eera. Miidhaan kun kan mudate magaalaa Yerikoo cinaatti yoo ta'u, lakkoofsi namoota miidhamanii dabalaa jiraachuu gabaasameera.

title: Watch: Arab-Israeli party denounces Netanyahu over 'attempted coup'
english: Yousef Jabareen of the Arab-Israeli Joint List has accused outgoing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of orchestrating an attempted coup. These allegations stem from reports claiming Netanyahu's office plotted to frame Arab politicians prior to the recent election. Jabareen emphasized that the severity of these claims requires a thorough investigation and cannot be ignored.
amharic: የአረብ-እስራኤል የጋራ ዝርዝር ፓርቲ መሪ የሆኑት ዩሴፍ ጃባሪን፣ ከስልጣን እየወረዱ ባሉት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ላይ የመፈንቅለ መንግስት ሙከራ ፈጽመዋል ሲሉ ከሰሱ። ይህ ክስ የተሰነዘረው የኔታንያሁ ቢሮ ባለፈው ወር በተካሄደው ምርጫ ወቅት አረብ ፖለቲከኞችን በማዕቀፍ ለመክሰስ መሞከሩን የሚገልጹ ዘገባዎች በመውጣታቸው ነው። ጃባሪን የክሱ ክብደት ከፍተኛ በመሆኑ ጉዳዩ በቸልታ ሊታለፍ እንደማይገባ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni paartii 'Joint List' kanneen akka Yuuseef Jaabareen, muummichi ministeeraa aangoo gadi lakkisaa jiran Beniyaamiin Neetaan yaahuu yaalii fonqolcha mootummaa godhaniiru jechuun himatan. Himannaan kun kan ka'e, biiroon Neetaan yaahuu filannoo darbe dura siyaasota Arabaa irratti yakka sobaa akka dhaaban gabaasni ifoomuun isaa hordofee dha. Jaabareen himannaan kun hamma akkasii waan ta'eef, dhimmi kun akka salphaatti ilaalamuu akka hin qabne ibseera.

title: Israeli settlers shoot, wound five Palestinians near Jericho, Red Crescent says
english: Five Palestinians were injured after being shot by Israeli settlers in the West Bank village of al-Duyuk al-Tahta, located near Jericho. Medical reports confirming the incident were provided by the Palestinian Red Crescent. The attack occurred in the occupied territory as part of ongoing regional tensions.
amharic: በኢያሪኮ አቅራቢያ በምትገኘው አል-ዱዩክ አል-ታህታ መንደር በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች በተከፈተ ጥይት አምስት ፍልስጤማውያን ቆስለዋል። ጉዳዩን የፍልስጤም ቀይ ጨረቃ ማህበር ያረጋገጠ ሲሆን ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሰዎች በህክምና ላይ እንደሚገኙ ተገልጿል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ውስጥ ነው።
oromo: Naannoo Yerikoo ganda Al-Duyuk Al-Tahta jedhamutti namoonni saba Israa'eel irraa dhufan dhukaasa bananiin lammiileen Falasxiin shan miidhamaniiru. Dhaabbanni Gargaarsa Gadaadduu (Red Crescent) Falasxiin akka ibsetti, miidhamtoonni kun wal'ansa fayyaa argachaa jiru. Miidhaan kun kan qaqqabe naannoo Qilleensa Qilleensaa (West Bank) kan qabame keessatti dha.

title: Tanker transiting Strait of Hormuz attacked near Oman: UKMTO
english: A tanker ship was struck by an attack while passing through the Strait of Hormuz near Oman, causing an engine room fire that left the vessel disabled. Although the ship sustained damage, all crew members are reported to be safe. Authorities are currently assessing the full impact of the incident.
amharic: በኦማን አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ውስጥ ሲጓዝ የነበረ የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከብ ጥቃት ደርሶበታል። ጥቃቱ በመርከቧ የሞተር ክፍል ውስጥ እሳት በማስነሳት መርከቧ የመንቀሳቀስ አቅሟን እንድታጣ አድርጓል። ምንም እንኳን በመርከቧ ላይ ጉዳት ቢደርስም፣ ሁሉም የመርከቡ ሠራተኞች ደህና መሆናቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Dooniin boba'aa fe'atte tokko yeroo gara Ormaanitti dhiyaatu qaxxaamuraa Hormuz keessa jirtu haleellaan ishee mudateera. Haleellaan kun kutaa injiinii doonichaa keessatti ibidda kaasuun dooniin sun akka hin sochoone godheera. Dooniin sun miidhamus, hojjattoonni hundi nagaa akka qaban gabaafameera.

title: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
english: Five European nations, including Germany and the Netherlands, have partnered with Rwanda to establish a deportation hub for migrants who have no legal right to remain in the EU. Scheduled to begin in 2027, the program will initially focus on single men and provide them with the choice to either settle in Rwanda with access to local services or return to their home countries. While these governments argue the plan will reduce the burden on European asylum systems and deter human traffickers, human rights organizations have raised concerns about the potential violation of migrant rights.
amharic: ጀርመንንና ኔዘርላንድስን ጨምሮ አምስት የአውሮፓ ሀገራት በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ የሚገኙ ስደተኞችን ወደ ሩዋንዳ የሚልኩበት ማዕከል ለመክፈት ተስማምተዋል። በ2027 የሚጀመረው ይህ ፕሮግራም በመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ለብቻቸው ለሚጓዙ ወንዶች ትኩረት የሚሰጥ ሲሆን፣ ስደተኞቹ በሩዋንዳ የመኖር ወይም ወደ ሀገራቸው የመመለስ አማራጭ ይኖራቸዋል። አባል ሀገራቱ ይህ እርምጃ የአውሮፓን የስደተኞች አያያዝ ጫና እንደሚቀንስ ቢገልጹም፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ግን የሰውን ልጅ መብት ሊጥስ ይችላል በሚል ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Biyyoonni Awurooppaa shan kanneen akka Jarmanii fi Neezerlaandi, godaantota biyya isaanii keessa seeraan ala turan gara Ruwaandaatti erguuf waliigaltee tokko mallatteessaniiru. Sagantaan bara 2027 eegaluu kun jalqaba irratti dhiirota kophaa isaanii godaanan irratti kan xiyyeeffatu yoo ta'u, godaantonni kunneen Ruwaandaa keessa jiraachuuf ykn gara biyya isaaniitti deebi'uuf carraa ni qabaatu. Biyyoonni kunneen tarkaanfin kun sirna godaantotaa Awurooppaa irratti jiru salphisa jedhanii kan amananii fi seeraan walsimu jedhanis, dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa garuu mirga godaantotaa cabsuu danda'a jechuun yaaddoo qaban ibsaniiru.

title: Trump backs return of ex-Nvidia boss after 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign launched
english: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is facing calls for reinstatement from high-profile tech figures and supporters following his resignation over personal scandals. President Donald Trump has expressed support for his return, even as Nvidia's board maintains that they are not considering rehiring him. Meanwhile, the Trump administration has implemented tighter restrictions on AI chip exports to prevent China from accessing advanced technology.
amharic: የኤንቪዲያ ዋና ሥራ አስፈፃሚ የነበሩት ጄንሰን ሁዋንግ በግል ቅሌቶች ምክንያት ከሥራ መልቀቃቸውን ተከትሎ፣ አንዳንድ የቴክኖሎጂ ዘርፍ መሪዎችና ደጋፊዎቻቸው ወደ ሥራቸው እንዲመለሱ እየጠየቁ ነው። ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ሁዋንግ ወደ ሥራቸው ቢመለሱ እንደማይቃወሙ የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ የኤንቪዲያ ቦርድ ግን እንደገና የመቅጠር ፍላጎት እንደሌለው አስታውቋል። በሌላ በኩል፣ የአሜሪካ መንግሥት ቻይና የላቀ የኤአይ ቺፕ ቴክኖሎጂን እንዳታገኝ ለመከላከል የወጪ ንግድ ገደቦችን አጠናክሯል።
oromo: Hogganaan duraanii dhaabbata Nvidia Jensen Huang, dhimma ejjannoo dhuunfaatiin walqabatee hojiirraa erga gadi bu'anii booda, deeggarsa gurguddoo namoota tekinooloojii biraa argachaa jiru. Prezidaantiin Donald Trump deebii isaanii kan deggaran ta'us, boordiin Nvidia ammayyuu gara hojiitti deebisuuf yaadne hin jiru jedheera. Kana gidduutti, mootummaan Trump tekinooloojii AI kan ta'e chipiiwwan gara Chaayinaatti akka hin geenyeef daangaa daldalaa haaraya baaseera.

title: Landmark Crimea bridge hit as Russia reports biggest Ukrainian drone attack of war
english: Russia recently faced its largest drone attack since the war started, with over 2,000 drones launched at various targets. The assault caused minor damage to the strategic Kerch Bridge connecting Russia to Crimea and sparked fires at several oil refineries. In retaliation, Russian strikes hit Kyiv and disrupted power for 50,000 people, resulting in at least seven deaths amid ongoing high-level peace discussions.
amharic: ሩሲያ ጦርነቱ ከተጀመረ ወዲህ ትልቁ የተባለውን የድሮን ጥቃት አስተናግዳለች፤ ከሁለት ሺህ በላይ ድሮኖች በተለያዩ ኢላማዎች ላይ ተጠቅመዋል። ጥቃቱ ሩሲያን ከክሬሚያ ጋር የሚያገናኘውን የከርች ድልድይ ላይ ቀላል ጉዳት ያደረሰ ሲሆን በነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎች ላይም የእሳት አደጋ አስከትሏል። ለዚህ ምላሽ በወሰደችው እርምጃ ሩሲያ በኪቭ ላይ ጥቃት በመሰንዘሯ በሃምሳ ሺህ ሰዎች ላይ የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ አጋጥሟል፤ እንዲሁም ሰባት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸውን አጥተዋል።
oromo: Raashiyaan jalqaba waraanaa irraa kaasee kan ta’e weerara xiyyaaraa kanaan dura hin mul’anne kan muuxatte yoo ta’u, xiyyaaronni 2,000 ol ta’an imala isaanii gara garaa irratti gaggeeffamaniiru. Weerara kanaan daandiin ce’umsaa Kerch kan Raashiyaa fi Crimea wal qunnamsiisu miidhaa xiqqoo irra ga’eera, akkasumas lafa gubataa boba’aa tokko tokko irratti ibidni ka’eera. Raashiyaan gama isheen, magaalaa Kyiv irratti tarkaanfii fudhatteen namoonni torba du’anii, namoonni 50,000 immoo ifaa dhabaniiru.

title: When will we see Robert Pattinson as Bond in cinemas?
english: Robert Pattinson has been officially cast as the seventh actor to play the legendary spy James Bond. The upcoming film will be directed by Denis Villeneuve and is scheduled to begin production in 2027. While a specific release date has not been confirmed, the movie is expected to arrive in theaters in 2028.
amharic: ሮበርት ፓቲንሰን ታዋቂውን ሰላይ ጄምስ ቦንድን የሚጫወት ሰባተኛው ተዋናይ ሆኖ በይፋ ተመርጧል። ፊልሙ በዴኒስ ቪልኑቭ የሚመራ ሲሆን ቀረጻውም በ2027 እንደሚጀመር ይጠበቃል። ምንም እንኳን ትክክለኛው ቀን ባይገለጽም፣ ፊልሙ በ2028 ወደ ሲኒማ ቤቶች እንደሚመጣ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Robert Pattinson akka ta'e 007 (James Bond) kan taphatu ta'uun isaa ifatti beekameera. Filmiin kun kan qajeelfamu Denis Villeneuve-dhaan yoo ta'u, hojiin suuraa kaasuus bara 2027 akka eegalu ni eegama. Guyyaan inni itti gadhiifamu hanga ammaatti kan hin murtoofne ta'us, bara 2028 akka qophaa'uuf karoorfameera.

title: Five EU countries announce plan to send rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda
english: Five European nations, including Germany and Austria, are planning to send asylum seekers who were denied entry to a processing facility in Rwanda. The initiative aims to discourage illegal migration and disrupt human smuggling networks by offering migrants the option to return home, settle in Rwanda, or move elsewhere. However, numerous human rights organizations have strongly condemned the proposal, expressing serious concerns regarding the safety and potential mistreatment of the displaced individuals.
amharic: ጀርመንንና ኦስትሪያን ጨምሮ አምስት የአውሮፓ ሀገራት ጥያቄያቸው ውድቅ የተደረገባቸውን ጥገኝነት ጠያቂዎች ወደ ሩዋንዳ ለመላክ አቅደዋል። ይህ እቅድ ህገ-ወጥ ስደትን ለመከላከል እና የሰዎች ህገ-ወጥ አዘዋዋሪዎችን ስራ ለማቆም ያለመ ሲሆን፣ ስደተኞች ወደ ሀገራቸው እንዲመለሱ፣ በሩዋንዳ እንዲኖሩ ወይም ወደ ሌላ ቦታ እንዲሄዱ አማራጭ ይሰጣቸዋል። ይሁን እንጂ በርካታ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች የስደተኞችን ደህንነት አደጋ ላይ ይጥላል በሚል እቅዱን በጥብቅ ተቃውመዋል።
oromo: Biyyoonni Awurooppaa shan kanneen akka Jarmanii fi Awustiriyaa, gaaffiin kooluuggattummaa isaanii fudhatama hin argatin gara Ruwaandaatti erguuf karoorfataa jiru. Karoorri kun godaansa seeraan alaa hir'isuu fi gareewwan namoota seeraan alaa godaansisan qabachuu kan kaayyeeffate yoo ta'u, godaantonni gara biyya isaanii deebi'uu, Ruwaandaa keessa jiraachuu ykn gara biyya biraatti deemuu akka danda'an taasiisa. Ta'us, dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa hedduun karoora kana jabeessanii mormuun, nageenyaa fi mirga godaantotaa irratti miidhaan dhaqqabuu danda'a jechuun yaaddoo isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Saudi Arabia dismisses commander of coalition forces fighting Houthis
english: Saudi Arabia has replaced its top coalition commander, General Fahd bin Hamad al-Salman, with General Fayyad al-Ruwaili. This leadership change occurs as coalition forces retreat from the Red Sea coast to strengthen the defense of Aden, the interim capital of Yemen. The withdrawal follows significant military setbacks against Houthi fighters, who have moved closer to the city after gaining control of key coastal areas.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ በየመን የጦር አዛዧን በመቀየር ጄኔራል ፋያድ አል-ሩዋይሊን አዲሱ የጥምረት ኃይሎች አዛዥ አድርጋ ሾማለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው የጥምረት ኃይሎች ከቀይ ባህር ዳርቻ አካባቢዎች በመውጣት የየመንን ጊዜያዊ ዋና ከተማ አደን ለመከላከል በዝግጅት ላይ እያሉ ነው። ሑቲዎች በቅርቡ ወሳኝ የሆኑ የባህር ዳርቻ ቦታዎችን በመቆጣጠር ወደ አደን በመቅረባቸው፣ ጥምረቱ በጦርነቱ ላይ ከፍተኛ ፈተና ገጥሞታል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan ajajaa loltootaa ishee kan Yemen keessatti lolaa jiran bakka buustee, General Faayyaad al-Ruwaayilii ajajaa haaraa godhatteetti. Jijjiirraan kun kan godhame yeroo loltoonni kun dirree gara galaana diimaa gadi lakkisanii magaalaa Aden, magaalaa guddoo yerootii taate, ittisuuf qophaa'aa jiranitti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe erga gareen Huutii bakkeewwan bakka bu'iinsa galaana irratti argaman to'annoo isaanii jala galchanii fi gara magaalaa Adenitti dhihaachuu jalqabanii booda.

title: Thousands report difficulties accessing accounts online at major US banks
english: Numerous customers of major US banks, such as JPMorgan Chase and Wells Fargo, are facing significant technical issues with online services. Users have reported difficulties logging in, checking account balances, and completing fund transfers. Banks have attributed these problems to technical errors rather than cyberattacks and are currently working on restoration.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የሚገኙ ዋና ዋና ባንኮች እንደ ጄፒ ሞርጋን ቼዝ እና ዌልስ ፋርጎ ያሉ ተቋማት የኢንተርኔት አገልግሎት መስተጓጎል አጋጥሟቸዋል። ደንበኞች ወደ አካውንታቸው በመግባት፣ የሂሳብ መጠናቸውን በማየት እና የገንዘብ ዝውውሮችን ለማድረግ ችግሮች እንዳጋጠሟቸው ገልጸዋል። የባንክ ተቋማቱ ችግሩ የቴክኒክ ብልሽት እንጂ የሳይበር ጥቃት አለመሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ መፍትሄ ለመስጠት እየሰሩ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Baankiwwan gurguddoo Ameerikaa kanneen akka JPMorgan Chase fi Wells Fargo tajaajila interneetii irratti rakkoo mudateen miidhamaniiru. Maamiltoonni gara herrega baankii isaaniitti seenuuf, qabiyyee herregichaa mirkaneeffachuuf, akkasumas maallaqa dabarsuuf rakkoo akka qaban gabaasaniiru. Baankiwwan kun rakkoon kun kan dhufe miidhaa teeknikaatiin malee haleellaa interneetii irraa akka hin taane ibsuun, ariitiin sirreessuuf hojjechaa jiraachuu beeksisaniiru.

title: Is Israel’s Eisenkot bloc less right wing than Netanyahu?
english: As Israel faces complex government formation talks, former military chief Gadi Eisenkot is attempting to build a coalition to move away from Benjamin Netanyahu's hard-right policies. His opposition bloc aims to restore judicial oversight, investigate the security failures of October 7, and mandate military service for ultra-Orthodox youth. However, skeptics question if this new group, which still includes various right-wing figures, will truly represent a significant ideological shift from the previous administration.
amharic: እስራኤል አዲስ መንግስት ለመመስረት በምታደርገው ድርድር፣ የቀድሞው ወታደራዊ መሪ ጋዲ አይዘንኮት የቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የጽንፈኛ ቀኝ አዝማሚያ የለቀቀ ጥምረት ለመመስረት እየሞከሩ ነው። የአይዘንኮት ተቃዋሚ ቡድን የፍትህ ስርአቱን ነጻነት ለመመለስ፣ በጥቅምት 7 የነበረውን የደህንነት ክፍተት ለመመርመር እና ለአልትራ-ኦርቶዶክስ ወጣቶች የግዴታ ወታደራዊ አገልግሎት ለመጣል አቅደዋል። ነገር ግን፣ ይህ አዲስ ቡድን በውስጡ የተለያዩ የቀኝ ዘመም አባላትን የያዘ በመሆኑ፣ ከቀድሞው አስተዳደር የተለየ ለውጥ ያመጣል ወይ የሚለው ጥርጣሬ አለ።
oromo: Israa'el mootummaa haaraa hundeessuuf marii geggeessaa jirtuun, ajajaan waraanaa duraanii Gadi Eisenkot yaada Benjamin Netanyahu irraa adda ta'e diriirsuuf carraaqqii gochaa jira. Gareen mormituu Eisenkot seerota mana murtii fooyyessuuf, dogoggora nageenyaa Mudde 7 qorachuuf, akkasumas dargaggoota amantii fayyadamoo ta'aniif tajaajila waraanaa dirqama gochuuf karoorfateera. Haata'u malee, gareen kun namoota mirga-qabiyyee (right-wing) of keessaa qabuuf, mootummaa duraa irraa garaagarummaan guddaan jiraata moo hin jiraatu kan jedhu shakkiin jira.

title: Yemeni forces' retreat leaves Houthis in control of key area on coast of Red Sea waterway
english: Yemeni pro-government forces, supported by Saudi Arabia, have withdrawn from strategic positions near the Bab al-Mandab Strait, allowing Houthi rebels to take control of the area. Military officials stated that these troops are being redirected to protect the interim capital, Aden, from potential threats. This shift in control is significant as the strait is a vital shipping route for global oil, raising concerns about trade stability.
amharic: በሳውዲ አረቢያ የሚደገፉት የየመን የመንግስት ሃይሎች በባብ አል-ማንዳብ የባህር ወሽመጥ አቅራቢያ ከነበሩ ወሳኝ ቦታዎች በመውጣታቸው አካባቢውን የሁቲ አማፂያን እንዲቆጣጠሩት ሆኗል። ወታደራዊ አመራሮች እንደገለጹት ወታደሮቹ ወደ ጊዜያዊዋ ዋና ከተማ አደን የተዛወሩት ከተማዋን ለመከላከል ነው። ይህ የቁጥጥር ለውጥ ለዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ ወሳኝ በሆነው በዚህ የባህር መስመር ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Yemen kan sa'udi arabiyaan deggeraman, daangaa galaana Bab al-Mandab keessatti iddoowwan tarsiimoo ta'an gad-lakkisuun isaanii humnonni Huutii akka achi to'atan taasiseera. Ajajoonni waraanaa akka jedhanitti, loltoonni kunneen gara magaalaa guddoo yeroo Adan kan deebi'an, magaalaa kana balaa irraa ittisuuf jedhanii dha. Jijjiiramni to'annoo kun daldala boba'aa addunyaaf karaa murteessaa ta'e irratti waan raawwateef, yaaddoo nageenyaa uummata addunyaa irratti guddisuu danda'a.

title: Third US aircraft carrier arrives in Middle East amid tensions with Iran
english: The United States has deployed a third aircraft carrier, the USS Theodore Roosevelt, to the Middle East. This move strengthens the American military presence in the region alongside two other carriers already stationed there. The deployment follows rising regional instability and reports of Iranian-linked attacks on sites associated with the US in Bahrain.
amharic: አሜሪካ ሶስተኛውን የጦር አውሮፕላን ተሸካሚ መርከብ ዩኤስኤስ ቴዎዶር ሩዝቬልትን ወደ መካከለኛው ምስራቅ ልካለች። ይህ እርምጃ በአካባቢው ቀድሞ ከነበሩት ሁለት መርከቦች ጋር በመሆን የአሜሪካን ወታደራዊ አቅም ያጠናክራል። ውሳኔው የተላለፈው በክልሉ እየጨመረ የመጣውን ውጥረት እና በባህሬን በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ተቋማት ላይ የተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶችን ተከትሎ ነው።
oromo: Amerikaa doonii xiyyaara feetu kan sadaffaa, USS Theodore Roosevelt jedhamtu gara Baha Giddugaleessaatti ergiteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun dooniiwwan kanaan dura achi turan lamaan wajjin ta'uun humna waraana Amerikaa naannichatti cimsedha. Murtoon kun kan dhume, walitti bu'iinsa naannichatti dabalaa jiruufi haleellaa buufataalee Amerikaa kanneen Baahireen keessa jiran irratti gaggeeffamaa jiru hordofuunidha.

title: Ronaldinho comes out retirement for 45 mins in Italy’s third division
english: Football icon Ronaldinho has briefly returned to the pitch for a 45-minute appearance in an Italian third-division match. This marks his first time playing in a professional setting in over a decade. The 46-year-old athlete surprised fans by stepping out of retirement for this special game.
amharic: የእግር ኳስ ኮከብ የሆነው ሮናልዲንሆ ከጡረታ ወጥቶ በጣሊያን ሶስተኛ ዲቪዚዮን ጨዋታ ላይ ለ45 ደቂቃ ተጫውቷል። ይህ ክስተት ከ11 ዓመታት በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ወደ ፕሮፌሽናል እግር ኳስ የተመለሰበት ነው። የ46 ዓመቱ አትሌት ለዚህ ልዩ ጨዋታ ከጡረታ በመመለሱ አድናቂዎቹን አስገርሟል።
oromo: Leenjisaan kubbaa miilaa beekamaan Ronaldinho waggaa kudha tokko booda gara tapha profeshenalaa deebi'uun, biyya Xaaliyaanii keessatti tapha sadarkaa sadaffaa irratti daqiiqaa 45f taphateera. Umriin isaa waggaa 46 kan ta'e kun, tapha kanaaf jecha hojii isaa isa duraan dhaabee ture irraa yeroo gabaabaaf deebi'uun warra isa arguuf dhufan dinqisiiseera.

title: Kachin: where Myanmar’s rare earth minerals are in tight grip
english: The Kachin state in northern Myanmar holds significant deposits of valuable rare earth minerals. Accessing these resources is currently difficult for the United States because of the region's geographic closeness to China. These minerals remain under tight control, making them a point of geopolitical tension.
amharic: በሰሜናዊ ምያንማር የሚገኘው የካቺን ግዛት ከፍተኛ ዋጋ ያላቸውን ብርቅዬ ማዕድናት በውስጡ ይዟል። ክልሉ ከቻይና ጋር ባለው መልክዓ ምድራዊ ቅርበት ምክንያት አሜሪካ እነዚህን ማዕድናት ለማግኘት ትልቅ ተግዳሮት ገጥሟታል። እነዚህ ማዕድናት በጥብቅ ቁጥጥር ስር በመሆናቸው በጂኦፖለቲካዊ ውጥረት ውስጥ እንዲገቡ አድርጓቸዋል።
oromo: Godina Kaachin kan kaaba Miyaanmar keessatti argamu qabeenya albuudaa gati jabeessa ta'e of keessaa qaba. Naannoon kun biyya Chaayinaa waliin daangaa kan qabu waan ta'eef, Ameerikaan albuuda kana argachuuf rakkoo guddaa keessa jirti. Albuudni kun to'annoo cimaa jala kan jiru yoo ta'u, kunis dhimma siyaas-diinagdee cimaa ta'ee jira.

title: Ahmed Tibi appointed as deputy speaker of Israel’s Knesset
english: Ahmad Tibi, the leader of the Ta'al party, has been elected as a deputy speaker of the Israeli Knesset. Despite opposition from right-wing figures, his appointment marks a significant moment for the Joint List following their recent electoral success. Tibi intends to use this position to advocate for the rights of Palestinian citizens and has also recently demanded a criminal investigation into allegations of election interference by the Prime Minister's office.
amharic: የታአል ፓርቲ መሪ የሆኑት አህመድ ቲቢ የእስራኤል ፓርላማ ምክትል አፈ-ጉባኤ ሆነው ተመርጠዋል። ምንም እንኳን የቀኝ ዘመም ፖለቲከኞች ተቃውሞ ቢገጥማቸውም፣ ይህ ምርጫ በቅርቡ በተደረገው ምርጫ ለተገኙት ውጤቶች ትልቅ ማሳያ ነው። አህመድ ቲቢ ይህንን ስልጣን በመጠቀም ለፍልስጤም ተወላጅ እስራኤላውያን መብት እንደሚታገሉ የገለፁ ሲሆን፣ በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ቢሮ ላይ የቀረበውን የምርጫ ጣልቃ ገብነት ክስ አስመልክቶም ምርመራ እንዲደረግ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan paartii Ta'al Ahmad Tiibii gargaaraa dubbi himaa mana maree Israa'el (Knesset) ta'uun filataman. Mormii garee mirgaa irraa isaan mudateen ala, filannoon kun injifannoo gareen Joint List filannoo darbe keessatti argateef beekamtii guddaa dha. Tiibiin aangoo kana fayyadamun mirga lammiilee Falasxiin kan Israa'el keessa jiraatan kabachiisuuf akka hojjetan beeksisanii, gabaasa biiroo muummee ministiraa keessatti walitti dhufeenya filannoo waliin walqabatu irratti qorannoon yakkaa akka godhamu gaafataniiru.

title: Over 2,000 people cross over from Senegal into Spain’s Canary Islands
english: In just two days, approximately 2,000 migrants successfully traveled by boat from Senegal to Spain’s Canary Islands. This journey highlights the ongoing use of a perilous Atlantic maritime route by individuals seeking a better life in Europe. Many people continue to risk their lives on this dangerous path despite the significant dangers involved.
amharic: በሁለት ቀናት ውስጥ ብቻ ወደ 2,000 የሚጠጉ ስደተኞች ከሴኔጋል በጀልባ ወደ ስፔን ካናሪ ደሴቶች ተጉዘዋል። ይህ ጉዞ በአውሮፓ የተሻለ ህይወት ለመፈለግ አደገኛውን የአትላንቲክ የባህር መስመር የሚጠቀሙ ስደተኞች ቁጥር አሁንም ከፍተኛ መሆኑን ያሳያል። ብዙ ሰዎች በጉዞው ላይ ያሉትን ከፍተኛ ስጋቶች ቢገነዘቡም ለተሻለ እድል ህይወታቸውን ለአደጋ ማጋለጣቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Guyyoota lama keessatti qofa namoonni godaantota ta'an gara 2,000 ga'an Seenegaal irraa dooniidhaan gara gizeebata Kaanaarii kan Ispeen imalaniiru. Imalli kun namoonni jireenya gaarii Awurooppaa keessatti argachuuf jecha karaa galaana Atilaantiik kan balaa guddaa qabu fayyadamuun isaanii itti fufeera. Namoonni hedduun balaa jiru hunda beekus, abdii gara fuulduraa isaanii fooyyeffachuuf jecha lubbuu isaanii qorumsaaf saaxiluudhaan imala kana godhu.

title: Australian MP who lost both legs in alleged car attack discharged from hospital
english: Australian lawmaker Helen Haines has left the hospital following a serious incident last month where she was intentionally struck by a vehicle, resulting in the amputation of her legs. A 43-year-old man has been charged in connection with the attack, though police have not yet determined a clear motive. The event has prompted national concern regarding the safety of public officials and the impact of intense political rhetoric in the country.
amharic: የአውስትራሊያዋ የፓርላማ አባል ሄለን හේንስ ባለፈው ወር በመኪና ሆን ተብሎ ከተገጩ በኋላ ሁለት እግሮቻቸውን አጥተው ለህክምና ሆስፒታል ገብተው የነበረ ሲሆን አሁን ከህክምና ተቋሙ ወጥተዋል። በወንጀሉ የተጠረጠረ አንድ የ43 ዓመት ሰው በቁጥጥር ስር ውሎ ክስ የተመሰረተበት ቢሆንም፣ የጥቃቱ ዓላማ እስካሁን በፖሊስ አልታወቀም። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በሀገሪቱ የፖለቲካ ሰዎች ደህንነት እና በፖለቲካዊ ክርክሮች ውስጥ የሚታየው የጥላቻ ንግግር እያስከተለ ስላለው ስጋት በስፋት እንዲወያዩ አድርጓል።
oromo: Miseensi paarlamaa Awustiraaliyaa Helen Heens ji'a darbe konkolaataan yommuu isaan rukutu miila isaanii lamaan erga dhabanii booda gara mana yaalaatti galanii turan, amma garuu mana yaalaa gadi lakkifamaniiru. Namni umuriin isaa 43 ta'e tokko haleellaa kanaan walqabatee himatamee jiraatus, sababni haleellichaa hanga ammaatti ifa hin taane. Ta'ichi kun nageenya qondaaltota mootummaa fi dhiibbaa dubbii cimaa siyaasaa irratti biyyattii keessatti yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira.

title: Mexican drug lord Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo dies age 80
english: Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo, a notorious Mexican drug kingpin known as the 'Boss of Bosses,' has passed away in a hospital at the age of 80. He famously led the Guadalajara Cartel and revolutionized drug trafficking by establishing major supply routes for Colombian cocaine into the United States during the 1980s. After being imprisoned in 1989 for his involvement in the murder of a DEA agent, he spent his final years under house arrest due to declining health.
amharic: የሜክሲኮው ታዋቂ የዕፅ አዘዋዋሪ ሚጌል አንጄል ፌሊክስ ጋላርዶ በ80 ዓመታቸው በሆስፒታል ህክምና ላይ እያሉ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። እርሳቸው በ1980ዎቹ የጓዳላጃራ ካርቴልን በመምራት የኮሎምቢያን ኮኬይን ወደ አሜሪካ በማስገባት የዕፅ ዝውውር ስራውን በማስተባበር ይታወቃሉ። እ.ኤ.አ በ1989 የአሜሪካ የዕፅ መቆጣጠሪያ ወኪልን በመግደል ወንጀል ከታሰሩ በኋላ፣ በጤና መታወክ ምክንያት ባለፉት ጥቂት ዓመታት በእስር ቤት ቁጥጥር ስር ሆነው ሲታከሙ ቆይተዋል።
oromo: Gooftaan yakka qoricha sammuu namaa hadoochu kan Meksikoo, Miigel Anjeel Feelikis Gaalaardoo, umrii waggaa 80tti hospitaala keessatti du'aniiru. Inni hoogganaa garee yakka 'Guadalajara Cartel' ture; bara 1980ota keessa kokaayinii Kolombiyaa gara Ameerikaatti guuruun daldala dhokataa kana kan jijjiire ture. Bara 1989 keessa ajjeechaa hordoftuu yakka daldala qoricha sammuu (DEA) wajjin walqabatee hidhamanii turan; waggoota dhumaa jireenya isaanii immoo dhukkuba isaaniitiin walqabatee mana hidhaa fi manuma keessatti hordoffii yaalaa godhamaafii turaniiru.

title: Prince Harry praises war veterans on surprise visit to Ukraine
english: Prince Harry made an unannounced trip to Ukraine to visit wounded veterans and support participants of the Invictus Games. During his stay, he toured rehabilitation centers and expressed his admiration for the country's progress in trauma treatment and innovative medical technology. He offered words of encouragement to the service members, highlighting Ukraine's unique expertise in managing modern war injuries.

oromo: Pirensi Haarii gara Yukreen deemee waraana madaayan fi hirmaattota tapha Invictus Games akka tasaa daawwateera. Pirensichi waraana miidhaan irra gaheef jajjabina kennuun, Yukreen miidhaa waraanaa ammayyaa wal'aanuudhaan sadarkaa olaanaa irra akka jirtu dubbateera.

title: Pope condemns murders of Peru’s Indigenous leaders, deforestation of Amazon
english: During his visit to the Peruvian Amazon, Pope Leo XIV strongly condemned the ongoing destruction of the rainforest and the killing of environmental activists. He criticized the harmful impacts of illegal mining and oil extraction on both the land and local communities. The Pope expressed his full support for Indigenous groups striving to defend their territories and demanded justice for the dozens of leaders murdered for their advocacy.

oromo: Pappaan Leo XIV daawwannaa isaan bosona Amaazon kan Peeruu godhaniin, mancaatii bosonaa fi ajjeechaa namoota naannoo eegan irratti raawwatamu cimsanii balaaleffatan. Hojiin al-seeraa kan akka baay'ee baasuu fi boba'aa baasuu naannichaa fi hawaasa naannoo irratti miidhaa geessisaa jiru akka balaaleffatan ibsaniiru. Pappaan kun, lammiileen naannoo lafa isaanii eeggachuuf qabsoo godhan akka deeggaran ibsuun, hogganoota qabsoo kanaaf jedhanii ajjeefamanifis haqni akka argamu gaafataniiru.

title: Pope urges end to Amazon deforestation
english: Pope Francis has called for an immediate halt to the destruction of the Amazon rainforest, highlighting the dangers posed by illegal mining and logging. He emphasized that ecological preservation is deeply linked to social justice and the protection of local populations. The Pope urged for a balanced approach that secures the environment while safeguarding the rights of those residing in the region.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ፍራንሲስ በአማዞን የደን መጨፍጨፍና ሕገ-ወጥ የማዕድን ቁፋሮ በአካባቢው እና በነዋሪዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት በመፍጠሩ እንዲቆም አሳሰቡ። የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ከማህበራዊ ፍትህ እና ከአካባቢው ማህበረሰብ መብት ጋር በቅርበት የተሳሰረ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በመሆኑም የተፈጥሮ ሀብትን ከመጠበቅ ጎን ለጎን የአካባቢውን ህዝብ ደህንነት ማስጠበቅ እንደሚያስፈልግ አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Papaa Firaansis bosonna Amaazonirratti mancaatiin fi qotannaan al-seeraa hawaasa fi naannicharratti balaa hamaa geessisaa waan jiruuf, hatattamaan akka dhaabbatu waamicha dhiyeessaniiru. Eegumsi naannoo fi haqa hawaasummaa wal-qabatee kan deemuu qaban ta'uu ibsanii, jiraattonni naannichaa akka hin miidhamne taasisuun barbaachisaa ta'uu hubachiisaniiru.

title: Founder of Guadalajara cartel dies in hospital after decades in prison
english: Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo, a pioneer of the Mexican drug trade and founder of the Guadalajara cartel, has passed away in a hospital at age 80. He had been incarcerated since 1989 for his involvement in the 1985 murder of a U.S. drug enforcement agent. Known as the 'boss of bosses,' his criminal network laid the foundation for modern drug trafficking, fueling decades of violence and instability in the region.
amharic: የሜክሲኮው የጉዋዳላጃራ ካርቴል መስራች ሚጌል አንጀል ፌሊክስ ጋላርዶ በ80 ዓመታቸው በሆስፒታል ህክምና ላይ እያሉ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። እ.ኤ.አ በ1985 አንድ የአሜሪካ የፀረ-አደንዛዥ እፅ ወኪልን በመግደላቸው ጥፋተኛ ተብለው ከ1989 ጀምሮ በእስር ቤት ቆይተዋል። 'የአለቆች አለቃ' በመባል የሚታወቀው ጋላርዶ፣ ዘመናዊውን የአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ዝውውር መዋቅር በመዘርጋት በክልሉ ለበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት የዘለቀ የጦርነትና የሁከት መነሻ ሆነዋል።
oromo: Hundeesitoon garee yakka 'Guadalajara cartel' kan Meksikoo, Miigel Anjeel Feeliks Gaallaardoo, waggaa 80tti hospitaala keessatti lubbuun isaa darbeera. Bara 1989 irraa eegalee, ajjeechaa ergamaa gargaarsa farra qoricha sammuu Ameerikaa tokko kan bara 1985 raawwatamee ture irratti hirmaachuun isaa mirkanaa'ee hidhaa keessa ture. 'Mootii moototaa' jedhamee kan beekamu Gaallaardoon, gurmaa'ina daldala qoricha sammuu ammayyaa lafa kaayee, naannichatti waraanaafi jeequmsa waggoota dheeraaf itti fufeef sababa guddaa ta'eera.

title: After a nationwide ground stop, US faces aviation infrastructure questions
english: The US Federal Aviation Administration recently grounded all domestic flights for several hours due to a technical failure during an infrastructure upgrade, causing widespread travel chaos for millions. While President Trump has requested additional funding to modernize the system, Democratic lawmakers are questioning why previous investments have not been utilized effectively. Ongoing investigations are now focused on why a contractor’s efforts to replace outdated wiring led to such a significant disruption to national flight operations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የሲቪል አቪዬሽን ባለስልጣን በቴክኒክ ችግር ምክንያት በሀገር አቀፍ ደረጃ በረራዎችን ለተወሰኑ ሰዓታት ማቆሙን ተከትሎ ከፍተኛ የጉዞ መስተጓጎል ተከስቷል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ለስርአቱ ማሻሻያ ተጨማሪ በጀት ቢጠይቁም፣ የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲ አባላት ግን ቀደም ሲል የተመደበው በጀት ለምን በአግባቡ እንዳልተጠቀምበት ጥያቄ እያነሱ ነው። በአሁኑ ወቅት የአቪዬሽን ስርአቱን ለማዘመን የተከናወነው የመሠረተ ልማት ስራ ችግር እንዴት ሊፈጥር እንደቻለ ምርመራ እየተካሄደ ይገኛል።
oromo: Hojii gaggeessaan balalii Ameerikaa rakkoo tekinikaa giddugaleessa haaraa irratti muudateen walqabatee balaliin hundinuu sa'aatii muraasaaf akka dhaabatu ajajeera, kunis imaltoota miliyoona hedduutti miidhaa geessiseera. Pirezidanti Traamp sirna kana ammayyeessuuf maallaqa dabalataa gaafatanis, miseensonni paartii mormituu maallaqni kanaan dura ramadame maaliif akka hin hojjetamne gaaffii kaasaa jiru. title: Czechs rally against gov’t threat to media independence
english: Thousands of protesters gathered in Prague to demonstrate against the Czech government's proposal to change how public media is funded. The current plan involves removing license fees and moving broadcast financing directly into the state budget. Opponents fear that this shift could jeopardize the independence of journalists and subject public media outlets to political pressure.

Mormitoonni tarkaanfiin kun bilisummaa miidiyaa fi gaazexeessitootaa miidhee, miidiyaaleen mootummaa dhiibbaa siyaasaa jala akka galan sodaatu.

title: Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'
english: President Volodymyr Zelensky has called on the US government and Elon Musk to remove speed restrictions on the Starshield satellite system, which is vital for Ukraine's defense. These technical limitations are currently hindering Ukraine's ability to intercept Russian missiles and drones, particularly as the country prepares for a difficult winter. Zelensky emphasized that fixing this connection issue is a moral imperative that is essential for protecting Ukrainian infrastructure and lives.

title: Czechs rally against plan to switch funding of public media
english: Thousands of people recently gathered in Prague to protest a government plan to replace the public media license fee with state budget funding. Critics fear this change will threaten journalistic independence and allow politicians to exert control over broadcasters. While the government claims the move is a necessary update and will not impact editorial freedom, opponents argue it risks silencing objective reporting.

title: Australia, Canada, Italy and the UK urge Israel to allow aid into Gaza
english: Australia, Canada, Italy, and the UK have issued a joint call for Israel to immediately permit humanitarian aid to enter Gaza. These nations report that 150,000 tents and other essential relief items are currently being blocked at the border despite the severe humanitarian crisis caused by recent flooding. They emphasized that Israel must remove these obstacles to prevent further suffering as winter approaches and displaced families face a desperate need for shelter.

title: US Treasury chief calls for outsider to lead embattled tech firm Nvidia
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has urged Nvidia’s board to appoint an external candidate as their new CEO following the resignation of co-founder Jensen Huang. Huang stepped down after reports surfaced regarding an extramarital affair with an individual suspected of links to Chinese intelligence. The company has also been given a 10-day deadline to prove it is following US export control regulations amid concerns over national security.

title: Yemen’s Houthis unilaterally release 600 war detainees
english: The Houthi movement in Yemen has independently released 600 prisoners held during the ongoing civil war. This action is part of a larger amnesty program that has resulted in the freedom of over 2,600 detainees to date. According to the International Committee of the Red Cross, this specific release was carried out by the Houthis on their own rather than through formal exchange negotiations.

title: Photos: Pope Leo visits Peru’s Amazon and Andean regions during 12-day tour
english: Pope Leo XIV recently concluded a 12-day tour of South America with final stops in Peru’s Andean and Amazonian regions. During his visit to Cusco and Pucallpa, he encouraged the preservation of Indigenous traditions and spoke out against the violence targeting environmental defenders. As the first Peruvian-born pope, he used his platform to call for justice and environmental protection amidst ongoing issues like deforestation and illegal mining.

title: Palestinians reclaim Gaza’s shores with a swim for hope
english: For the first time in over three years, the Gaza swimming federation organized a competition involving more than 200 participants. Families gathered on the coastline to cheer as the athletes raced, offering a rare moment of joy amidst the ongoing regional violence. This event provided a brief but meaningful escape from the daily hardships caused by the conflict.

title: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack
english: Iran recently launched two separate drone attacks against a US military base located in Bahrain. Bahraini defense systems successfully intercepted these attempts, preventing any significant damage or casualties. This escalation is part of a broader conflict between the two nations regarding control and security over the strategic Strait of Hormuz.
amharic: ኢራን በባህሬን በሚገኝ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ በሁለት ቀናት ውስጥ ሁለት ጊዜ ድሮን ጥቃት ሰንዝራለች። የባህሬን መከላከያ ኃይሎች ጥቃቶቹን መክተው በመጣላቸው ምንም ዓይነት ጉዳት አልደረሰም። ይህ ግጭት የተፈጠረው ሁለቱ ሀገራት በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት የባህር መተላለፊያ ቁጥጥር ላይ ባላቸው አለመግባባት ሳቢያ ነው።
oromo: Iiraan buufata waraana Ameerikaa kan Bahrain keessatti argamu irratti guyyoota lama keessatti al lama haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) gaggeessiteetti. Humnoonni ittisaa Bahrain haleellaa kana hatattamaan waan fashaleessaniif miidhaan tokkollee hin geenye. Walitti bu’insi kun kan uumame biyyoonni lameen kun to’annoo daandii galaana Hormuz irratti walii galuu waan hin dandeenyeefi.

title: South Korea's top scorer in tax accountancy exam admits cheating
english: A South Korean man who achieved the top score on a professional tax accounting exam has confessed to using a hidden camera and artificial intelligence to cheat. He admitted to photographing test questions to receive answers via his smartphone, which led to widespread outrage as government officials now vow to increase exam security. Consequently, the individual will lose his certification and face a five-year ban from taking the exam, while authorities investigate how to prevent similar incidents in the future.
amharic: በደቡብ ኮሪያ ከፍተኛውን የግብር የሂሳብ አያያዝ ፈተና ውጤት ያስመዘገበ አንድ ግለሰብ፣ የተደበቀ ካሜራ እና አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ በመጠቀም እንዳታለለ አምኗል። ግለሰቡ የፈተና ጥያቄዎችን በካሜራ ቀርጾ በስልኩ አማካኝነት መልሶችን እንደተቀበለ የገለጸ ሲሆን፣ ይህ ድርጊት በሀገሪቱ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞን አስነሳ። በመሆኑም የተሰጠው ውጤት ተሰርዞ ለቀጣይ አምስት ዓመታት ፈተናውን እንዳይወስድ የተከለከለ ሲሆን፣ መንግስትም ለወደፊቱ ተመሳሳይ ማጭበርበሮችን ለመከላከል ጥብቅ እርምጃዎችን እንደሚወስድ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Namni Kooriyaa Kibbaa keessatti qormaata herrega gibiraa irratti qabxii olaanaa galmeessise tokko, kaameeraa dhokataa fi teeknoolojii AI fayyadamuudhaan akka gowwoomse amaneera. Gaaffii qormaataa kaameeraadhaan fudhatee deebii isaa bilbila harkaa isaa irratti akka argate erga amanee booda, mootummaan gara fuulduraatti qormaata irratti to'annoo cimaa akka godhu ibseera. Bu'aan isaa akka haqamuufi waggaa shanf qormaata kana akka hin fudhanne kan dhorkame yoo ta'u, mootummaan gocha akkanaa kana ittisuuf tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatu beeksiseera.

title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
english: Alice Huang, a suspected Chinese spy linked to former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, departed her executive role at the Singaporean firm Megaspeed in 2025. This development follows Jensen Huang's resignation amid a scandal involving personal affairs and allegations that Megaspeed may have bypassed US export restrictions to supply restricted AI chips to China. Megaspeed is currently conducting an internal investigation, while US officials are scrutinizing the oversight of chip exports following these security concerns.
amharic: ከኤንቪዲያ የቀድሞ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ጄንሰን ሁዋንግ ጋር ግንኙነት አላት የተባለችውና የቻይና ሰላይ ናት ተብላ የምትጠረጠረው አሊስ ሁዋንግ በ2025 ከሲንጋፖሩ ሜጋስፒድ ኩባንያ መልቀቋ ተነግሯል። ይህ የሆነው የኩባንያው የቀድሞ አለቃ በግል ጉዳዮችና ከፍተኛ የቴክኖሎጂ ቺፖችን ለቻይና በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ አሳልፈዋል በሚል ቅሌት ስልጣናቸውን ከለቀቁ በኋላ ነው። ሜጋስፒድ የውስጥ ምርመራ እያደረገ ሲሆን፣ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናትም የቺፕ ኤክስፖርት ቁጥጥር ስርዓት ላይ ጥያቄዎችን እያነሱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Alis Huwaang, namni akka humni basaasaa Chaayinaatti shakkamtee fi hogganaa duraanii Nvidia, Jeensen Huwaang wajjin walitti dhufeenya qabdu jedhamte, bara 2025 dhaabbata Singapoori Meegaaspdiin gadi lteetti. Rakkoon kun kan dhufe erga Jeensen Huwaang dhimma dhuunfaa fi teeknooloojiiwwan Nvidia gara Chaayinaatti seeraan ala ergamanirratti himatamee booda. Meegaaspdiin amma qorannoo keessaa gaggeessaa jiru yoo ta'u, mootummaan Ameerikaas dhimma raabsaa teeknooloojii kanarratti qorannoo cimaa jalqabeera.

title: Israel kills Hamas commander in strike on Gaza camp, officials say
english: Israeli forces have killed Samir Abu Younis, a high-ranking Hamas commander who was involved in organizing the October 7, 2023, attacks. The strike occurred at a camp for displaced people in Al-Mawasi, Gaza, after the military identified him as a key figure working to rebuild Hamas operations. While Israel stated it attempted to reduce civilian harm, Hamas condemned the attack as a cowardly assassination.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል ጥቅምት 7 ቀን 2016 ዓ.ም የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት በማቀናበር የተሳተፈውን ከፍተኛ የሃማስ አዛዥ ሳሚር አቡ ዩኒስን በጋዛ የአየር ጥቃት መግደሉን አስታውቋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈፀመው በጋዛ አል-ማዋሲ በተባለ መጠለያ ካምፕ ውስጥ ሲሆን እስራኤል አዛዡ የሃማስን አቅም ለማደስ እየሰራ ነበር ብላለች። እስራኤል ጥቃቱን ከመፈጸሟ በፊት የሲቪሎችን ጉዳት ለመቀነስ ጥረት ማድረጓን የገለጸች ሲሆን ሃማስ ግን ድርጊቱን ፈሪሃዊ ግድያ በማለት አውግዞታል።
oromo: Humnootiin Israa'el ajaja olaanaa garee Hamaas kan ta'an Saamir Abuu Yuunis, weerara Onkoloolessa 7, 2023 qindeesuuf gahee qaban ajjeesuu isaanii ibsan. Ajjeefama kanatti kanneen dhibbetti argaman kaampii Gaza keessatti erga isaan qorannoon adda baafaman booda haleellaa qilleensaan kan raawwatame dha. Israa'el ajajaan kun humna Hamaas deebisanii ijaaruuf hojjetaa akka ture kan ibsite yoo ta'u, miidhaa siviloota hambisuuf yaalii gochuu ishee himte; gama biraatiin Hamaas ajjeechaa kana gocha suukanneessaa jechuun balaaleffateera.

title: Nearly 1,500 migrants reach Spain’s Canary Islands in one day
english: Nearly 1,500 migrants arrived at Spain’s Canary Islands in a single day, marking the highest volume of arrivals in one day since 2020. The individuals traveled in 14 separate boats, mostly originating from Senegal, The Gambia, and Guinea. Rescue services were mobilized to assist those reaching the islands.
amharic: በአንድ ቀን ውስጥ ወደ ስፔን የካናሪ ደሴቶች ወደ 1,500 የሚጠጉ ስደተኞች የገቡ ሲሆን ይህም ከ2020 ወዲህ የታየ ከፍተኛው ቁጥር ነው። እነዚህ ሰዎች በ14 ጀልባዎች ተጉዘው የደረሱ ሲሆን አብዛኞቹ የመጡት ከሴኔጋል፣ ከጋምቢያ እና ከጊኒ ነው። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች ደሴቶቹ ላይ የደረሱትን ስደተኞች ለመርዳት ተንቀሳቅሰዋል።
oromo: Guyyaa tokkotti godaantonni 1,500 ta’an gara kutaalee gannaa Ispeen, Kanari Aayilandi ga’an, kunis bara 2020 as lakkoofsa guyyaa tokkotti hanga kana ga’e guddaa dha. Namoonni kunneen doonii 14 gargar ta’aniin kan imalan yoo ta’u, hedduun isaanii biyyoota Senegaal, Gaambiyaa fi Giinii irraa dhufan. Tajaajilli gargaarsa namoomaa namoota gara biyyattii ga’an kana gargaaruuf bobba’eera.

title: Morocco becomes first Arab nation in FIFA’s top five men’s rankings
english: Morocco has made history as the first Arab nation to break into the top five of FIFA’s men's football rankings. The team achieved this milestone after rising two spots following impressive performances in recent matches. This accomplishment adds to their record-breaking success, which includes consecutive World Cup quarterfinal appearances and a strong showing in current Africa Cup of Nations qualifying.
amharic: ሞሮኮ በፊፋ የወንዶች እግር ኳስ ደረጃ አሰጣጥ በአምስቱ ምርጥ ሀገራት ውስጥ በመግባት የመጀመሪያዋ የአረብ ሀገር በመሆን ታሪክ ሰርታለች። ቡድኑ ይህንን ስኬት ያገኘው በቅርብ ጊዜ ባሳየው ጥሩ ብቃት ደረጃውን በሁለት ደረጃዎች በማሻሻል ነው። ይህ ስኬት በተከታታይ የዓለም ዋንጫ ሩብ ፍጻሜ መድረሷን እና በአፍሪካ ዋንጫ ማጣሪያ እያሳየች ያለውን ጠንካራ እንቅስቃሴ ተከትሎ የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Morookoon biyya Arabaa jalqabaa taatee tarree sadarkaa FIFA keessatti gosoota shanan ol aanaa keessatti argamuun seenaa hojjetteetti. Gareen kun sadarkaa isaa sadarkaa torbaffaa irraa gara shanaffaatti kan ol guddiifate taphoota isaanii darban irratti qophii gaarii taasisuun isaaniitiin. Milkaa'inni kun injifannoo garoota kubbaa miillaa biyyattii kanneen akka waancaa addunyaa fi qulqulleeffannaa waancaa Afrikaarratti argatan kan gargaaru dha.

title: Yemeni government forces redeploy from Bab al-Mandeb to defend Aden
english: Yemeni government-aligned forces are withdrawing from the Bab al-Mandeb region to prioritize the defense of Aden. This strategic shift aims to protect the interim capital from potential Houthi advances while redirecting resources to help break the ongoing siege in Taiz. The move marks a setback for recent government efforts to reclaim western coastal territories held by Houthi fighters.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ደጋፊ ኃይሎች አደን ከተማን ለመከላከል ሲሉ ከባብ አል-ማንደብ አካባቢ እየወጡ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ስልታዊ እርምጃ ዋና ከተማዋን ከሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ጥቃት ለመጠበቅ እና የታኢዝን ከበባ ለመስበር ያለመ ነው። ይህ ውሳኔ መንግስት በቅርቡ በምዕራብ የባህር ዳርቻ ያደረገውን ጥቃት በማስተጓጎል በጦርነቱ ላይ አዲስ ለውጥ ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Humnooni mootummaa Yaman magaalaa Aden eeguuf jechuun naannoo Bab al-Mandeb irraa gadi lakkisanii bahuuf murteessaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun magaalaa Aden weerara Huthirraa ittisuuf fi magaalaa Ta’izitti marfamee jiru furuuf kan gargaaruudha. Murtoon kun humnooni mootummaa bakkeewwan guddina qaban to’achuuf godhaniin turan akka daangeffamu taasisa.

title: The hidden costs of the US AI boom
english: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence in the United States is leading to public opposition against the construction of new data centers. Local residents are increasingly worried about the environmental impact, specifically regarding excessive noise, pollution, and the massive electricity requirements of these facilities. This tension highlights the growing conflict between the demand for advanced technology and the concerns of the communities hosting the necessary infrastructure.
amharic: በአሜሪካ ውስጥ ያለው ፈጣን የሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) እድገት አዳዲስ የመረጃ ማዕከላት ግንባታ ላይ ህዝባዊ ተቃውሞ እያስነሳ ነው። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች በእነዚህ ተቋማት የሚፈጠር ከፍተኛ የድምፅ ብክለት፣ የአየር መበከል እና ግዙፍ የኤሌክትሪክ ፍጆታ ስጋት እያደረባቸው ይገኛል። ይህ ሁኔታ ለዘመናዊ ቴክኖሎጂ ያለው ከፍተኛ ፍላጎት እና መሰረተ ልማቱ በሚገነባባቸው አካባቢዎች የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ስጋት መካከል ያለውን መቃቃር ያሳያል።
oromo: Guddina saffisaa 'Artificial Intelligence' (AI) jedhamuun biyya Ameerikaatti mul'achaa jiru, ijaarsa bakkeewwan odeeffannoo (data centers) haaraa irratti mormii uummataa kaasuu jalqabeera. Jiraattonni naannichaa dhageettii sagalee ol'aanaa, faalama qilleensaa fi akkaataa humna ibsaa guddaa barbaadan kanaaf yaaddoo qabu. Kuni immoo walitti dhufeenya guddina teeknoolojii fi yaaddoo uummata naannoo buufataalee kanaa jidduu jiru ifa godha.

title: Somalia: We would not have recovered without the international community
english: Somali official Ali Mohamed Omar credits international support for the country's progress since its government collapsed three decades ago. While the nation has begun managing its own affairs after a long-running UN mission ended, it still faces significant hurdles including the al-Shabab insurgency and reduced funding for regional peacekeepers. The government remains focused on stabilizing the country and hopes to maintain foreign financial aid to build a stronger state.
amharic: የሶማሊያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አሊ መሐመድ ኦማር፣ አገሪቱ ከሠላሳ ዓመታት በፊት ከወደቀችበት ጊዜ አንስቶ ላስመዘገበችው መሻሻል ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ያደረገው ድጋፍ ወሳኝ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ሶማሊያ የራሷን ጉዳይ በራሷ ለመምራት እየጣረች ቢሆንም፣ በአል-ሸባብ ቡድን የሚደርሰው ጥቃት እና ለሰላም አስከባሪ ኃይሎች የሚደረገው የገንዘብ ድጋፍ መቀነስ ከፍተኛ ፈተና ሆኖባቸዋል። መንግስት መረጋጋትን ለማስፈን እየሰራ ሲሆን፣ ጠንካራ አገር ለመገንባት ዓለም አቀፍ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እንደሚያስፈልገው አስታውቋል።

Mootummaan biyyattii tasgabbeessuuf hojjechaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, gama dinagdeetiin deeggarsa biyyoota alaa akka barbaadu beeksiseera.

title: Fifth Canadian soldier dies from injuries caused by large fire at military base
english: A fifth Canadian soldier has passed away from injuries sustained during a massive grass fire at CFB Wainwright last month. The blaze was triggered by a grenade launcher during a training exercise and spread rapidly due to high winds, causing dozens of casualties. Officials confirm that 24 soldiers remain hospitalized as investigations into the incident continue.
amharic: ባለፈው ወር በዌይንራይት ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ በተነሳ የእሳት ቃጠሎ ጉዳት የደረሰበት አምስተኛው የካናዳ ወታደር ህይወቱ አልፏል። እሳቱ የተነሳው በስልጠና ወቅት በደረሰ ፍንዳታ ሲሆን በጠንካራ ንፋስ አማካኝነት በፍጥነት በመዛመቱ ብዙ ወታደሮች ተጎድተዋል። እስካሁን ድረስ 24 ወታደሮች በሆስፒታል ህክምና እየተከታተሉ ሲሆን የጉዳዩ ምርመራም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Ji'a darbe buufata waraanaa Wainwright keessatti balaa ibidda bosonaa mudateen walqabatee loltuun keenya shanaffaan lubbuun darbeera. Ibidni kun kan ka'e leenjii waraanaa irratti rukuttaa rookeettii booda yoo ta'u, qilleensa cimaan bal'achuu isaa hordofee loltoota hedduu miidheera. Amma ammaatti loltoonni 24 hospitaala keessatti wal'aanamaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, qorannoon balaa kanaas itti fufee jira.

title: Three men sentenced to death in Jordan over fatal church mass shooting
english: A Jordanian court has sentenced three men to death for a deadly shooting at a Greek Orthodox church last month that left nine people dead and dozens injured. The attackers, who were captured after a shootout with security forces, were convicted of terrorism-related charges, including conspiracy and weapon possession. King Abdullah II condemned the violence, and Jordan has since launched retaliatory military actions against militant groups in neighboring Syria.
amharic: የዮርዳኖስ ፍርድ ቤት ባለፈው ወር በግሪክ ኦርቶዶክስ ቤተክርስቲያን ላይ ዘጠኝ ሰዎችን የገደለ እና በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ያቁሰለ የሽብር ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል የተባሉ ሶስት ወንዶችን በሞት እንዲቀጡ ወሰነ። ጥቃቱን የፈጸሙት ሰዎች ከጸጥታ ሃይሎች ጋር ከተኩስ ልውውጥ በኋላ የተያዙ ሲሆን፣ በአሸባሪነት፣ የጦር መሳሪያ መያዝ እና በሽብር ተግባር ሴራ በመሳተፍ ጥፋተኛ ተብለዋል። ንጉስ አብዱላህ ሁለተኛ ድርጊቱን በጽኑ ያወገዙ ሲሆን፣ ዮርዳኖስም ለዚህ ጥቃት አጸፋዊ ምላሽ ለመስጠት በሶሪያ በሚንቀሳቀሱ ቡድኖች ላይ የአየር ጥቃት መፈጸሟ ይታወሳል።
oromo: Mana murtii Yordaanos keessatti namoonni sadii ji’a darbe mana sagadaa Ortodoksii Giriikii keessatti namoota sagal ajjeesuufi namoota hedduu miidhuun himataman du’aan adabaman. Shakkamtoonni kun humnoota nageenyaa wajjin erga wal-dhahanii booda qabamanii, shororkeessummaa, meeshaa waraanaa seeraan alaa qabachuu fi duula shororkeessummaa karoorfachuu irratti yakka qaban mirkanaa’eera. Mootii Abdullaah II gocha kana cimsanii balaaleffataniiru; Yordaanosis tarkaanfii kanaaf deebii kennuuf jecha gareewwan shororkeessaa biyya ollaa Siiriyaa keessatti argaman irratti haleellaa waraanaa raawwateera.

title: Police confront protesters in clashes across France and Germany
english: Massive demonstrations occurred across cities in France and Germany as people rallied against the rising cost of living, austerity measures, and school funding issues. Security forces responded to the large crowds by using water cannons and tear gas to break up the protests. Tens of thousands of participants joined these events to voice their frustration with current economic policies.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ እና በጀርመን ከተሞች እየጨመረ የመጣውን የኑሮ ውድነት፣ የቁጠባ እርምጃዎችን እና የትምህርት በጀት እጥረትን በመቃወም በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ሰልፍ ወጥተዋል። የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ሰልፈኞቹን ለመበተን የውኃ መርጫ እና አስለቃሽ ጭስ ተጠቅመዋል። በብዛት የተሰባሰቡት ተቃዋሚዎች በመንግስት የኢኮኖሚ ፖሊሲዎች ላይ ያላቸውን ቅሬታ በሰልፉ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Faranseeyyii fi Jarmanii keessatti namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman gatii jireenyaa dabaluu, tarkaanfii dinagdee cimaa fi dhimma baajata barnootaa mormuun hiriira bahaniiru. title: Give Donbas, take NATO seat: Could new US pitch work for Ukraine, Russia?
english: The U.S. government has proposed a potential peace deal where Ukraine could gain NATO membership in exchange for ceding control of the Donbas region to Russia. This suggestion was conveyed to President Zelenskyy by American negotiators following recent discussions with both Ukrainian and Russian leadership. While this move aims to resolve the long-standing conflict, it remains controversial as both nations have historically rejected these specific territorial and alliance-related compromises.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ዩክሬን የዶንባስን ክልል ለሩሲያ በመልቀቅ በምትኩ የኔቶ አባል መሆን የምትችልበትን የሰላም አማራጭ አቅርቧል። ይህ ሀሳብ በአሜሪካ ድርድር አቅራቢዎች በኩል ለፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ የደረሰ ሲሆን፣ ቀደም ሲልም ከሩሲያ መሪዎች ጋር ውይይት ተደርጎበታል። ምንም እንኳን ይህ እቅድ ጦርነቱን ለማቆም ያለመ ቢሆንም፣ ሁለቱም ሀገራት በቀድሞ አቋማቸው መሰረት የየራሳቸውን ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች በመያዛቸው ጉዳዩ አወዛጋቢ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa, Yukreen naannoo Donbaas gadi dhiistee yoo argatte miseensa NATO ta'uu akka dandeessu yaada nageenyaa dhiyeesseera. Yaadni kun waraana dhaabuuf kan karoorfame ta'us, biyyootni lamaanuu kanaan dura lafaafi bu'uura siyaasaa isaanii irratti walii galuun waan ulfaateef, ammaas fudhatama argachuun isaa shakkii keessa jira.

title: India’s Under-19 Asia Cup win over Pakistan marred by post-match aggression
english: India secured a dramatic one-wicket victory over Pakistan in the Under-19 Asia Cup final in Oman after a remarkable late-game comeback. Despite the impressive win, the celebration was tarnished by aggressive behavior from the Indian players toward their Pakistani counterparts. Former cricketers and fans have criticized these unsportsmanlike actions, emphasizing the importance of maintaining respect and composure regardless of the match outcome.
amharic: ሕንድ በኦማን በተካሄደው ከ19 ዓመት በታች የእስያ ዋንጫ ፍጻሜ፣ ፓኪስታንን በአስደናቂ ሁኔታ በአንድ ዊኬት በማሸነፍ ዋንጫውን ወስዳለች። ነገር ግን የድል በዓሉ በሕንድ ተጫዋቾች በፓኪስታን ተጫዋቾች ላይ ባሳዩት እጅግ አፀያፊ እና ጨዋነት የጎደለው ድርጊት ጥላ አርፎበታል። የቀድሞ የክሪኬት ተጫዋቾችና ደጋፊዎች ይህንን ድርጊት አውግዘው፣ በውጤቱ ላይ ሳይወሰኑ ስፖርታዊ ጨዋነትንና አክብሮትን ማስቀደም እንደሚገባ አስገንዝበዋል።

Taphattoonni durii fi hordoftoonni ispoortii gocha kana balaaleffachuun, injifannoo boodas ta'e kufaatii booda kabajaa fi tasgabbii qabaachuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Spain football coach denies racism ahead of England match
english: Spain's football coach, Luis de la Fuente, has rejected claims that racism is a prevalent issue within his country. This statement follows comments from England manager Thomas Tuchel, who indicated he would prepare his team regarding anti-racism procedures before their Nations League game. The exchange has sparked a renewed public conversation regarding the state of racial discrimination in Spanish sports.

title: Polls open in Cape Verde in race with first female presidential candidate
english: Voters in Cape Verde are heading to the polls to decide between incumbent President Jose Maria Neves and five challengers, including the country's first female presidential candidate, Joana Rosa. The election is focused on addressing the nation's significant emigration challenges driven by a lack of local job opportunities. While Neves is considered the favorite to secure a second term, the vote is a notable milestone in the archipelago's history of political stability.
